record.field: Factory shell. Paste a bearer token and activate. Discover downloads the public OpenAPI spec. Trusted stays off (Safe Plan toast).

WHEN TO USE (server "sesame"): - Employee time tracking, worked hours, check-ins, attendance, punctuality. - ALWAYS via propose_safe_operations op=api_call. NEVER RelaxAICode on ai.api.server, spec_json, or drivers.
RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW: 1. Find employee: ListEmployees (use limit + page; filter by email/name in your next step from returned data). 2. Aggregated worked hours: WorkedHoursByEmployee — REQUIRED: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: employeeIds[in]=[id], limit, page. 3. Raw check-ins / work entries: ListWorkEntries — employeeId, from, to, limit, page. 4. Monthly breakdown / punctuality: api_call ListWorkEntries or WorkedHoursByEmployee, then execute_relaxaicode ONLY to aggregate/format the JSON returned by api_call (never to call Sesame directly).
PAGINATION (mandatory): - Always pass limit (50–100) and page in arguments for ListEmployees, ListWorkEntries, WorkedHoursByEmployee. - If api_call result has truncated=true, read pagination.suggested_arguments and propose a follow-up api_call with those args. - Do not dump full company datasets in one call.
DO NOT: - Probe spec_json/tools_json via execute_relaxaicode or fetch_url swagger hunting. - Use fetch_url against api-eu4.sesametime.com for live HR data (api_call only). - Use type(...).__name__ or ORM shortcuts (_get_driver, .call) — blocked by sandbox.
EXAMPLES (api_call steps): - List employees page 1: {"server":"sesame","tool":"ListEmployees","arguments":{"limit":50,"page":1}} - Worked hours: {"server":"sesame","tool":"WorkedHoursByEmployee","arguments":{"from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-07-31","employeeIds[in]":[123],"limit":50,"page":1}} - Check-ins: {"server":"sesame","tool":"ListWorkEntries","arguments":{"employeeId":123,"from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-07-31","limit":100,"page":1}}
DATES: YYYY-MM-DD. This factory shell is not trusted — api_call waits for the Safe Plan toast.

Factory shell. Public apidocs.cdmon.com is not a usable OpenAPI document. Paste a converted spec into spec_json (or ship data/openapi/cdmon.json). Discover will not download spec_url. Paste a bearer token and activate.

WHEN TO USE (server "cdmon"): - Domain and DNS administration for the configured CDMON account. - ALWAYS via propose_safe_operations op=api_call. NEVER RelaxAICode on ai.api.server or spec_json.
WORKFLOW: - The admin must paste the converted OpenAPI document (Manual spec) before Discover can build the tool catalogue. - Use only tools from that catalogue. Pass pagination arguments when the schema has them.
DO NOT: - Uncheck Manual spec and Discover from https://apidocs.cdmon.com/openapi.json (not a usable spec). - Store tokens inside spec_json. - Call the API with fetch_url; use api_call only.
